sections.title: Terms & Conditions
sections.summary: The membership terms governing your Coopvest Africa account.
sections.body:
These Terms and Conditions govern your membership of Coopvest Africa and your use of the Coopvest mobile application and related services. By creating an account you agree to be bound by these terms.

1. Membership is open to individuals who are at least 18 years old and who complete the required identity verification (KYC) process.

2. You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide and for keeping your login credentials confidential.

3. Coopvest Africa provides cooperative savings, contribution, and credit services to registered members. Services may be updated, suspended, or withdrawn with reasonable notice.

4. You must not use the platform for any unlawful purpose, including fraud, money laundering, or the financing of prohibited activities.

5. Coopvest Africa may suspend or terminate accounts that breach these terms, subject to applicable law and the cooperative's bylaws.

6. These terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

sections.title: Fees & Charges
sections.summary: Every charge Coopvest Africa applies, with the amount, so nothing comes as a surprise.
sections.body:
Coopvest Africa charges the following, and nothing else. Each charge, its amount, and when it applies are set out below so you know exactly what to expect before you commit any money.

1. Registration fee: ₦5,000, one time. Non-refundable. It is a charge payable to the cooperative and is not added to your monthly contribution. If you join through an employer that deducts contributions at source, it is recovered through that deduction instead of being paid in the app.

2. Monthly contribution: ₦5,000 minimum. This is your own money, held in your savings. It is not a charge.

3. Monthly administrative fee: ₦1,500, made up of Administrative charges (₦1,000) and the Development levy (₦500). If your contributions are deducted by an employer, this is recovered from your salary and is not charged again in the app.

4. Loan interest: simple interest, charged once on the amount you borrow, at the rate shown for the product you choose before you apply: Stable Loan (12 months) 5%; Flexi Loan 7%; Stable Loan (18 months) 7%; Quick Loan 7.5%; Premium Loan 14%; Maxi Loan 19%. The total you repay is the amount borrowed plus this interest. There is no application fee, no processing fee, and no penalty for repaying early.

5. Late repayment fine: ₦3,000. This applies only after two consecutive missed monthly repayments, never on the first. It is recorded as a separate obligation and is not added to your loan balance.

6. Guarantor liability: standing as a guarantor is not a charge, but it is a real liability: you accept joint responsibility for that loan if the borrower defaults. It ends when the loan is fully repaid.

7. We do not apply any charge that is not listed here. There is no withdrawal fee, no fee for repaying a loan early, and no account-maintenance charge beyond the monthly administrative fee at item 3. If we introduce a new charge, or change an amount, we will tell you in the app before it takes effect and update this page.

sections.title: Contribution Policy
sections.summary: Monthly contribution rules: minimum ₦5,000, increases anytime, reductions require 3-month notice.
sections.body:
1. Every member must make a minimum monthly contribution of ₦5,000. A one-time, non-refundable registration fee of ₦5,000 also applies to all new members; it is a charge payable to the cooperative and is not added to your contribution.

2. Members may increase their monthly contribution at any time through the app, and the new amount takes effect from the next contribution cycle.

3. Requests to reduce a monthly contribution require a minimum of three (3) months' written notice to the cooperative.

4. Contributions may be made by manual monthly self-contribution or by salary deduction (payroll) through your employer.

5. Consistent contributions improve eligibility for future financial support services. Contribution history and account records are tracked digitally for transparency.

sections.title: Loan Policy
sections.summary: Loan eligibility criteria, guarantor requirements, and repayment obligations.
sections.body:
1. Loan eligibility is based on membership duration, contribution history, and the cooperative's prevailing credit policy.

2. Loan amounts, interest rates, and tenures are determined by the loan product selected and are displayed in the app before you apply.

3. Approved loans are disbursed to the bank account verified during registration.

4. Repayment is made in line with the repayment schedule shown at the time of application. Early repayment is allowed without penalty.

5. Failure to repay as scheduled may affect your credit standing within the cooperative, your eligibility for future loans, and may trigger the Default & Recovery Policy.

sections.title: Guarantor Requirement
sections.summary: Loans under the direct contribution model require three guarantors.
sections.body:
1. Loans accessed under the direct contribution model require three (3) guarantors who are themselves registered and contributing members of the cooperative.

2. Each guarantor must confirm their consent within the app before the loan application can proceed.

3. By standing as guarantor, a member accepts joint responsibility for the repayment of the guaranteed loan in the event of default.

4. Guarantor obligations end when the guaranteed loan is fully repaid.

sections.title: Default & Recovery Policy
sections.summary: Guarantors may be contacted in the event of prolonged loan default.
sections.body:
1. A loan is in default when a scheduled repayment remains unpaid beyond the grace period communicated at disbursement.

2. In the event of prolonged default, the cooperative may contact the borrower's guarantors to recover the outstanding balance.

3. Outstanding balances may be recovered from the member's contributions, savings, or dividends held with the cooperative, in line with the cooperative's bylaws.

4. Defaulting members may be reported to relevant credit bureaus as permitted by law.

sections.title: Registration Fee Policy
sections.summary: The ₦5,000 registration fee is non-refundable and is a charge payable to the cooperative.
sections.body:
1. A one-time registration fee of ₦5,000 applies to all new members.

2. The registration fee is non-refundable under any circumstances, including voluntary withdrawal or termination of membership.

3. The fee is a charge payable to the cooperative. It is not added to your monthly contribution.

sections.title: Privacy Policy
sections.summary: How we collect, store, and use your personal and financial data.
sections.body:
1. We collect the personal and financial information you provide during registration and KYC — including your name, contact details, identification documents, BVN, and bank account details — solely to provide cooperative financial services to you.

2. Your data is stored securely and processed in accordance with the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) and other applicable data protection regulations.

3. Bank account verification is performed through licensed, secure third-party providers; verification credentials are never stored on your device.

4. We do not sell your personal data. Data is shared only with service providers who need it to deliver the services you use, or where required by law or regulation.

5. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, subject to legal and regulatory retention requirements, by contacting support.
